verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as acting on many broadcasts or streams at once through an API or CLI, are a fair question for a media relay or CDN product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any such capability: fan-out to many viewers, automatic broadcast discovery and clustering are different features, and the moq-cli only imports and publishes broadcasts. No OpenAPI or management API was found by the probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
